title: A possible demonstration of cooperative dynamical Jahn-Teller effect in Raman scattering spectrum of rhombohedral $LaMnO_3$
abstract: The Raman scattering (RS) spectra of rhombohedral $LaMnO_3$ is considered. It is shown that broad high intensity RS line at 640 $cm^{-1}$ could be explained in the framework of cooperative dynamical Jahn-Teller effect. This hypothesis is illustrated through the lattice dynamics calculations explicitly allowing for the electron-phonon term both in crystal energy and in dynamical matrix. The averaging scheme for the one mode cooperative dynamical effect is proposed
